title: Building Permits Violation
description: Use this service request to report violations regarding active construction being performed that is not covered under the permit. Construction of accessory structures less than 200 SF, with no electric or plumbing work, does not require a permit. The estimated response time for a service request of this nature is 2 business days.

observedQuestions.label: What building permit violation are you reporting?
options: Construction is more extensive than what is covered by permit
Construction not according to approved plans

observedQuestions.label: Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

observedInstructions: All five violation types and three contact-preference answers were tested. Other adds a required description; no other violation type or contact-preference answer adds fields or routing messages.
detailsForm.contactStepObserved: Contact step showed optional consent; First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone Number, Address, City, State, Zipcode were disabled by default.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about construction that violates a building permit.
actions.why: Report active construction that goes beyond a permit, differs from approved plans, builds within setbacks, or raises a contractor or other building-permit concern. The 311 request form asks which violation is being reported.
actions.why_not: A small accessory structure under 200 square feet with no electrical or plumbing work does not require a permit under the description for "Building Permits Violation" requests on the Dallas 311 website.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Building Permits Violation"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Building Permits Violation"
